# nexusnet-cache

Smart caching layer for NexusNet with delta synchronization and deduplication.

## Planned responsibilities

- LRU and TTL caches
- Delta synchronization
- Object deduplication
- Memory-aware and on-disk tiers

## Status

Scaffolding established in **Phase 1 (Workspace & Foundation)**.
Implementation lands in **Phase 5**. See
[`docs/roadmap.md`](../../docs/roadmap.md) for the full plan.
